method:
Capture native file-format admission and its outgoing storage path offline.

The exact proprietary candidate-filter instruction slice and original format
getter execute over a synthetic native file variant. Decoder capability is an
explicit injected interface result; raw owner flags are inputs. If admitted,
the unchanged proprietary storage owner constructs the request path/headers.
Opaque builder/lifecycle/callback interfaces stop before dispatch. Standard
allocation, strings, decimal/hex conversion and memory primitives are provided.
No Spotify process, account, profile or network is used.
limitations: File variant2 only; other native candidate kinds excluded.
Single candidate admission and outgoing storage fields, not bitrate ranking or account flag production.
No HTTP backend, final transport serialization, Free-account entitlement or live playback claim.
